description: Add a comment to a media file. Three kinds: on the whole file (no quote or range), on words in the transcript (quote, or range plus expectedTranscriptRevision, exactly as in apply_label), or a reply to a thread (parentId, with no span of its own). Replies go one level deep, so parentId must be a thread's first comment. A reply notifies the thread's starter in Speak, unless the starter wrote the reply. mediaLabelId links the comment to a labelled span on this file. A 409 that says the transcript changed means someone edited it after your revision was read: read the transcript again (get_transcript) and retry with the new range or quote. Nothing was saved. Requires the comments create permission (every member by default). The change is recorded in your Speak Notifications under Comment (type comment).

expectedTranscriptRevision.description: transcriptRevision the range was read at (returned by get_transcript, list_media_labels and list_media_comments). Required with range. Optional with quote: the quote is found in the current transcript, and a revision you pass makes the call fail with 409 if the transcript changed since you read it.

mediaLabelId.description: mediaLabelId from list_media_labels to link the comment to

occurrence.description: Which match of quote to use (1 = first) when the quote appears more than once

parentId.description: commentId of the thread's first comment, to reply to it

quote.description: Words copied from the transcript, used instead of range. Matching ignores case and leading or trailing punctuation, and must cover whole words in order. If the words appear more than once, pass occurrence.

range.description: Exact word range. Needs expectedTranscriptRevision. Prefer quote unless you already hold word indices. Word indices count the words of get_transcript's insight.transcript in order, from 0: for each sentence, the words of its entities[].text when it has entities, otherwise its text split on spaces; tokens that are only punctuation are not counted.

end.description: Index of the last word (inclusive, >= start)

start.description: Index of the first word (0-based, inclusive)

name: add_comment

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
